title: Moderasi komentar
description: Moderasi komentar media sosial / forum: deteksi komentar toksik, pelecehan, ujaran kebencian, spam, dan tingkat keparahannya.

toxic.instructions: Is this comment toxic: rude, insulting, vulgar, or disrespectful?

criteria.false: polite or neutral, even if it disagrees or criticizes

harassment.instructions: Does this comment harass, bully, threaten, or personally attack a specific person?

hate.instructions: Does this comment attack or demean people based on religion, ethnicity, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality?

spam.instructions: Is this comment spam: an advertisement or promotion for a product, shop, website, gambling, or investment?

criteria.false: a personal opinion, question, or insult from a reader

criteria: not harmful: a normal, polite, or on-topic comment, including disagreement or criticism
somewhat harmful: rude words, insults, vulgarity, or spam advertising
very harmful: threats of violence, hate speech, or targeted harassment
